question: How many artists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist

question: How many albums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album

question: How many tracks are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track

question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer

question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee

question: How many genres are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM genre

question: How many invoices are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice

question: List all media type names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM media_type

question: List all genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM genre

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT country FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name FROM artist ar JOIN album al ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums does AC/DC have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'AC/DC'

question: What is the longest track by duration?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM track

question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock'

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name FROM genre g JOIN track t ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which billing country has the highest total sales?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the largest single invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM invoice

question: How many invoices were issued in 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2021

question: Who is the customer who has spent the most? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist

question: How many tracks are on the playlist with id 1?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_track WHERE playlist_id = 1

question: How many employees have the title Sales Support Agent?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: Which employee has no manager? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE reports_to IS NULL

question: How many customers does each support rep handle? Give rep id and count.
gold_sql: SELECT support_rep_id, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY support_rep_id

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track WHERE composer IS NULL

question: How many units were sold in total across all invoice lines?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM invoice_line

question: What is the most purchased track by quantity?
gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN invoice_line il ON il.track_id = t.track_id GROUP BY t.track_id, t.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC, t.track_id LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct cities do customers live in?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM customer

question: How many tracks use the MPEG audio file media type?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON m.media_type_id = t.media_type_id WHERE m.name = 'MPEG audio file'

question: What is the average invoice total per billing country? Give country and average.
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, AVG(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country
